questions.question: Should public control-plane ever adopt an external AWS SDK?
questions.stance: No. Stdlib-only adapters remain until an ADR accepts the dependency.
questions.next_artifact: dependency allowlist ADR or continued stdlib adapter evidence

questions.area: Agent catalog / AI Agent development durability
questions.question: Should final production persistence use assignment operation journals, separate catalog journals, or a DynamoDB single-table projection?
questions.stance: AI Agent client development state now uses a durable DynamoDB snapshot item plus bounded recent client stream replay events. Full production projection, agent catalog durability, and rotation/revocation topology remain future slices.

questions.question: Which IdP/JWKS claim mapping becomes the production authorizer contract?
questions.stance: External authorizer port is stable; tenant claim mapping remains outside public defaults.

questions.question: Should stdout EMF remain the only public metrics publisher, or should Prometheus/OpenTelemetry become a contract?
questions.stance: Stdout EMF is the only public publisher. Dashboards and exporters stay infra-owned.

questions.question: Should DynamoDB stream relay run in cmd/riido_ai_server or as a separate worker process?
questions.stance: Adapter core is public; runtime topology is infra/deployment-owned until decided.

questions.question: How are review/demo accounts rotated, disabled, and audited in production?
questions.stance: Public repo stores only safe seed shape and token-hash provisioning; operations lifecycle is private evidence.

questions.question: Should the Windows app waitlist, launch-notification, and marketing-consent action from Figma node-id=275-22731 and web onboarding node-id=236-29749 be implemented in the AI Agent control-plane client API or delegated to an existing product/user-marketing API?
questions.stance: Resolved as no-diff for the AI Agent control-plane client API. The generated client exposes only GET /v1/client/ai-agent/devices for runtime empty-state composition.
questions.resolution: Windows waitlist, launch notification, and marketing-consent actions remain client/product facts unless a future product/marketing SSOT defines a separate generated surface. This server must not expose AI Agent waitlist or marketing-consent endpoints.

loop.observation: The open questions page was a hand-maintained table, so unresolved decisions had no machine-checkable owner or next artifact.
loop.hypothesis: A decision queue manifest can generate the reader and verify that every open question has an owner and next executable artifact.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the open questions manifest and run the openquestions verifier in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on duplicate ids, unknown statuses, missing owners, missing next artifacts for open questions, or stale generated docs.
loop.retrospective: This keeps planning uncertainty visible without treating prose as the source of truth.
